non_mutating_precheck_scenario.description: Invalid probes using the same pending jti must fail prechecks WITHOUT burning the pending nonce, so the subsequent valid presentation succeeds

concurrent_replay_scenario.description: 32-way concurrent replay race over one valid jti must yield exactly 1 allow and 31 nonce_replayed denials
